card.name: The letter E starting Epoetin and EPIVIR
card.fires_on: The capital E that begins a drug name such as Epoetin or EPIVIR, most often right after "from", "previous" or "and" in a drug-label conversion or dosing passage. It also fires, more weakly, on "e" in "e.g." and on "to" in "Inability to stand".

modes.label: E opening Epoetin
modes.description: The first letter of Epoetin after "Conversion from" or "Previous" in erythropoiesis-stimulating agent dosing text.
modes.example: Conversion from<< E>>poetin alfa to Aranes

modes.label: E opening EPIVIR
modes.description: The first letter of EPIVIR in a list of antiretroviral brand names.
modes.example: See full prescribing information for ZIAGEN (abacavir) and<< E>>PIVIR (lamivudine

modes.label: e.g. and "to"
modes.description: Weaker firing on the "e" in "e.g." and on "to" after "Inability".
modes.example: Inability<< to>> stand or sit upright for at least

card.writes: No clear link to the tokens it promotes or suppresses. They are mostly unrelated code and heat words.
card.plain: It fires on the opening letter E of drug names like Epoetin and EPIVIR, so the model is partway into reading those names.
